meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求做“对抗式规划”时,Claude 先宣告“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”,再组建5个互相攻击对方结论的成员,只保留经得起攻击的结论,最后交给 plan 智能体写成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“adversarial plan”等触发词,或提出需要暴露薄弱假设、盲点和过度设计的规划请求时触发。

say.text: /hyperplan 帮我规划一个个人知识库系统
adversarial plan 对这份发布计划做批判性评审
say.note: 五位成员互相挑刺后产出可执行计划。

say.text: hpp 把新功能实现方案做成对抗式规划
say.note: 一开始会宣告 HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!

howto.what_en: On adversarial-planning requests, Claude announces 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!', forms 5 hostile members who attack each other's findings, keeps only the surviving insights, then mandates handoff to the plan agent to produce an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', etc., or ask for planning with maximum rigor to surface weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.

say_en.text: /hyperplan help me plan a personal knowledge-base system
adversarial plan review this release plan critically
say_en.note: Five members critique; surviving insights become a plan.

say_en.text: hpp make an adversarial plan for the new feature
say_en.note: First it announces HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!
